messages:
sre-ana: Heads up, apiserver latencies spiked in eu-west1 ~10:12 UTC and controller-manager started timing out leader-renewals. Noticed a bunch of Failed to dial node errors.
infra-jules: saw NAT gateway SNAT port exhaustion on the busiest k8s nodes, egress metrics show connection churn increasing when GPU onboarding pods scale up.
eng-matt: logs from apiserver show a lot of short TCP disconnects to kubelets and controller-manager leader-election renew failing: `error getting leader lease: dial tcp: i/o timeout`.
sre-ana: can someone dump conntrack /proc stats and SNAT port used counts from a problem node? suspect ephemeral port depletion + keepalive timings.
infra-jules: pasted quick check: `ss -s` -> "TCP: inuse 8232 orphan 0 tw 1123 alloc 32768 mem 1234` and `conntrack -S` shows short-lived entries spike. Also NAT gateway 4xx/5xx for ephemeral limit.
eng-matt: kube-controller-manager logs: `E0312 10:13:45.123 leader_election.go:290] error renewing lease: context deadline exceeded` — controller losing leadership briefly which causes reconciliation lag for GPU provisioning.
sre-ana: impact: GPU onboarding latency up x3, some pods stuck in ContainerCreating because kubelet CRI requests not reaching registry/pulling images due to SNAT failures.
infra-jules: short-term mitigation: reduce kubelet image pull parallelism and stagger GPU pool scale-up; also increase NAT gateway port pool if we can (cost hit).
eng-matt: config changes to try now: bump kube-apiserver keepalive from 30s -> 60s, controller-manager leader-election renewDeadline from 15s -> 30s, and reduce kubelet max-pods on affected nodes to drop concurrent outbound connections.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-089 - apiserver SNAT exhaustion causing controller-manager lease flaps. Severity: Sev3.
sre-ana: agree on staged plan: 1) apply leader-election & keepalive temp bumps (low risk) 2) throttle GPU onboarding templates (immediate) 3) request infra to scale NAT gateway pool for eu-west1 (cost-aware) 4) followup: add node-level SNAT monitoring and guardrails.
infra-jules: I can scale NAT pool now but need approval for extra cost. Rough estimate +$1.8k/day for the region at peak. :grimacing:
eng-matt: let's do the temporal config bumps and throttles first, then scale NAT if we still see errors after 15m. I'll open a PR for the kube flags.
sre-ana: PR merged, rolling kube-apiserver restart on eu-west1 canary started (deploy-bot scheduled).
deploy-bot: Scheduled rolling restart: kube-apiserver eu-west1 canary at 10:35 UTC (node eu-west1-a-3).
infra-jules: scaled ingress NAT pool by +30% as precaution (monitoring on).
sre-ana: telemetry looks better after 12 mins — apiserver p95 down from 600ms -> 150ms, leader-election errors reduced. Keeping throttles in place for 1hr then reassess. :thumbsup:
eng-matt: follow-up items: add automated backoff for GPU onboarding when SNAT usage > 75%, and add a dashboard alert for leader-election renew failures.
sre-ana: filing a short postmortem with action items. Thanks y'all.
